title: Geometric comparisons for the ordinary rectangle before right adjoints
statement: For qcqs X,Y,S,T, qcqs f:X→Y, g:S→Y, h:T→S, and k:(X×Y S)×S T→X×Y T satisfying both projection equations, assume the three ordinary base-change maps are isomorphisms on quasi-coherent complexes. With U,L,V,P,Q,B,H,alpha,delta as in lem-sc-rectangle-ordinary-pasting-comparisons, there are s:U⋙L≅V, p:L⋙Q≅P and b:B≅H such that L is an equivalence, Q(s_E) delta_E = p_{U(E)} alpha_E b_{Rf(E)}, and s has the canonical three-factor ambient pullback-composition component prescribed by hk₁. No right adjoints of P,Q or comparison of their counits is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 48.5.2 (0ATR), reduction to ordinary base-change pasting; Remark 20.28.3 (08HY), Remark 20.28.5 (0ATM), and Lemma 20.27.2 (0D5S)

proof.text: Identify k as the canonical iterated pullback isomorphism using its two projection equations. Its derived pullback restricts to an equivalence on quasi-coherent complexes. Restrict the canonical composition comparisons to obtain s and b; hk₁ gives precisely the stated ambient component of s.
Use derived direct-image composition, the pullback/direct-image equivalence for k and hk₂ to construct p.

Transpose both ordinary squares under the pinned pullback/direct-image adjunctions. The counit formula and associativity of pullback composition identify the transposes, hence the squares by injectivity. Invert all three ordinary base-change isomorphisms and use naturality to obtain the inverse-square identity. Empty schemes and zero complexes are included by the same functorial identities.

proof_origin.note: Split from the ordinary rectangle argument, keeping its geometric construction and adjunction transport separate.

theorem rectangle_ordinary_geometric_comparisons
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : S ⟶ Y) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) (h ≫ g)
        (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβS : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβI : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g),
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (k : pullback (pullback.snd f g) h ⟶ pullback f (h ≫ g))
    (hk₁ : k ≫ pullback.fst f (h ≫ g) =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hk₂ : k ≫ pullback.snd f (h ≫ g) = pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) :
    let U := qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))
    let L := qcPullback k
    let V := qcPullback (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
      qcPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let P := @qcDirectImage _ _ _ _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) _ _
      (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))
    let Q := @qcDirectImage _ _ _ _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)) _ _
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let B := qcPullback (h ≫ g)
    let H := qcPullback g ⋙ qcPullback h
    let α := qcInverseBaseChange f (h ≫ g) hβ
    let δ := qcInverseBaseChange f g hβS ≫ₕ
      @qcInverseBaseChange _ (pullback f g) S T _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h hβI
    ∃ (s : U ⋙ L ≅ V) (p : L ⋙ Q ≅ P) (b : B ≅ H),
      L.IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        Q.map (s.hom.app E) ≫ δ.app E =
          p.hom.app (U.obj E) ≫ α.app E ≫ b.hom.app ((qcDirectImage f).obj E)) ∧
      (∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι.map
            (s.hom.app E) =
          (let comp := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
            (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
           (comp k (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).hom.app E.obj ≫
             eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ (derivedPullback v).obj E.obj) hk₁) ≫
             (comp (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
               (pullback.fst f g)).inv.app E.obj))
